query:
update workouts
              set title = coalesce($3, title),
                  notes = coalesce($4, notes),
                  gym_id = coalesce($5, gym_id),
                  started_at = coalesce($6, started_at),
                  ended_at = coalesce($7, ended_at)
            where id = $1 and user_id = $2 and deleted_at is null
        returning id
